07 / BEFORE YOUR FIRST CALL

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Does this replace my dispatcher or office team?+

No. Your team keeps answering as usual. The backup handles calls forwarded to it when the main line goes unanswered or your configured routing sends them over.

Do I need to change my number or phone provider?+

You keep your existing number and phone service. We check which forwarding options your provider supports during setup, then test the handoff together.

Can it book repairs or quote springs and openers?+

The base setup gathers the door issue, address, urgency, and callback request. Scheduling or approved price ranges can be added only after your exact rules are scoped and tested.

What happens with an urgent stuck-open door?+

We follow the escalation rules you approve. The agent can flag that the property is unsecured, collect the right details, and use a configured transfer or callback route.

Will callers know it’s AI?+

The demo introduces the assistant as AI. A clear introduction sets expectations while keeping the conversation focused on what the caller needs.

Will it give dangerous DIY repair advice?+

No. The call flow is built to capture symptoms and urgency, not walk a homeowner through springs, cables, or other hazardous repairs. Your technician handles diagnosis and repair advice.

What does setup need from my garage door company?+

Your service area, hours, repair and installation types, emergency rules, callback instructions, and current phone provider. We also map questions about springs, openers, stuck doors, and new installations.

Does it make outbound sales calls?+

This offer is inbound only. Customers call your shop; your team handles follow-up. Cold calls and outbound campaigns are outside this service.
